title: Close-code registry
description: The WebSocket close codes of the Vault channel (close-codes.json), shared by the engine, the pages and the Vault. The close reason text is the code's name. A code from the Vault is a hint for what the page shows, never trusted for anything else. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Close codes.

pageShows.description: LINK_GONE: the link expired, was replaced or is incomplete, and how to get a new one (as the loopback NOT_FOUND reason LINK). ENGINE_OFFLINE: the agent's engine is not connected; ask the agent to check status, or use the long link. BROKEN: the connection was broken or tampered with and nothing was accepted; open the link again. TRY_LATER: busy or timed out; open the link again later.
